headline: Committee weighs flood and sea level criteria for zoning changes

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Committee weighs flood and sea level criteria for zoning changes.
meeting.recap: If the work is not finished, members agreed to continue on the 9th at 10.[[0:14:48]] The chair proposed criteria for properties with structures fully inundated (covered) in the sea level rise exposure area or in flood areas.[[0:15:24]] Planning staff said the 3.2 sea level rise area already includes the 3.2 erosion hazard line.[[0:20:46]] An attorney advising the committee said some legal questions would be better discussed in executive session (a closed-door meeting).[[0:45:34]] Under flood rules, staff confirmed improvements over 10 years cannot reach 50 percent of assessed value without meeting current code.[[0:52:28]] A council member proposed a yearly structural analysis as a condition of the zoning change.[[1:20:17]] Planning said it would not have staff to verify those reports.[[1:20:47]] Planning said it will check with corporation counsel (the County's lawyers) on the proposed conditions and report back.[[1:30:17]]
meeting.next: Planning will check with corporation counsel on the proposed conditions and try to get back to the committee. Planning offered to write out the proposed conditions, noting which may need executive session, for when the committee returns.

moments.q: Attorney suggests executive session for legal questions
